intended_object: An isomorphism of monoids h : M ≃* N gives the induced isomorphism of unit groups Mˣ ≃* Nˣ, which sends u to h(u). This comes from the docstring.
explanation: The forward map is `Units.map h`, the restriction of h to units. The inverse is `Units.map h.symm`. Two units are equal when their underlying elements are equal, so the left and right inverse properties follow from those of h. This is the standard functoriality of the units functor applied to an isomorphism. Monoids are the natural setting for unit groups, so the definition is not too narrow. Since this definition is Mathlib's own, there is no separate Mathlib counterpart to cite.
